### Summary

Adds the Stuqet design system: Urbanist typography, light and dark colour tokens, a restyled UI kit and new auth components.

### User-Facing Changes

- Stuqet Vendor now uses the Urbanist font, off-white screens with white shadowed fields, and orange pill buttons with white labels.
- Inputs show an orange focus border, red error state, green verified check and a muted locked state.
- Checkboxes are larger with rounded corners and an orange glow when checked.
- Sign-in, forgot-password and reset-password screens were rebuilt on the new design: round back button, 6-box reset-code entry, an inline "code sent" notice, and a new "Password updated" confirmation screen.
- The login screen shows Google and Apple buttons (tapping them shows a "coming soon" message until OAuth is available).
- The welcome screen has new copy and the soft corner artwork.
- New shop screens: Home with sales and order counters, Orders with status filters and order details (update delivery status, mark cash on delivery as paid), and Notifications.
- Catalogue for products and food: Products | Food lists, a published switch, and add forms (add product; add food in two steps with prep time, delivery options and availability), with photo upload.
- Money: balance, payments, withdrawal requests and commission, and a withdraw form.
- More: shop settings, verification, payout details, appearance and log out.
- Every screen has the soft peach corner background.
- Light and dark colour palettes were redefined around the Stuqet orange (`#EB6C1A`).

### Bug Fixes

- No bug fixes in this release.

### Testing Scope

- Set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` (the `/api/v2` root) and `EXPO_PUBLIC_SYSTEM_KEY`, log in as a seller, and walk every vendor screen against a staging backend; none of it has been run on a device yet.
- Full forgot-password flow: request code, enter code and new password, "Password updated" screen, sign in. Reset code length is assumed to be 6 digits.
- Sign-in, forgot-password and reset-password screens in light and dark theme: fields, focus/error states, button label legibility.
- Settings theme toggle switches every screen without un-themed (white or black) regions.
- Text renders in Urbanist on both iOS and Android (no fallback system font, bold weights correct).
- Select dropdown, segmented control, badges and checkbox look correct in both themes.

### Known Issues

- Needs backend changes before it works end to end: photo upload ids on create, product id in create responses, shop business category, list filters, and an `approved` flag in the product list. See stuqet-docs/audits/vendor-create-product-api-audit.md.
- Home shows only the product layout until the shop type is exposed. Support tickets and messages are not in the app yet.
- Google and Apple sign-in are not functional yet; the buttons only show a "coming soon" message.
- Google and Apple buttons use the Ionicons glyphs, not the official brand artwork.

### Rollback Notes

- Previous stable release: none (first tracked release).
- Rollback instructions: revert the design-system PR; no data or API migration is involved.
